**Is this already on the roadmap?**

Check [`docs/ROADMAP.md`](../../docs/ROADMAP.md) — the workflow inventory in
Part 1 lists what is known to be missing, and Part 4 says which phase covers
it. If it is already there, say which phase; if it isn't, that is useful to
know.

**Does this belong to MyMusic, or to the template?**

MyMusic is also a template for other social sites. Features that any social app
would want (identity, follows, feeds, notifications, moderation) are treated
differently from music-specific ones.
